FN-KF9VA5U-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 54
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/07/2024
Senate Bill 54 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama State Department of
Education by an estimated $4,000 per meeting to reimburse members of the State Textbook
Committee for travel and per diem to meetings to review, vett, and approve periodicals used
regularly during classroom instruction in any public K-12 school. In addition, this bill could
increase the administrative obligations of the State Board of Education to develop guidelines for
the review of periodicals separate from the State Textbook Committee review process.
